title: GTA 6 Money Glitch: Works in ANY CHAPTER (Tested in Chapter 2) - Apollo Aggregates Van Method
text:
GTA 6 money glitch: loot the Apollo Aggregates warehouse, fill a van, drive away for about half a minute and come back, and the van's cocaine is back. It works in any chapter, and I tested it in chapter 2.

This guide shows everything to loot on the first visit and exactly how the repeat works, step by step.

STEPS
1. Find Apollo Aggregates in South Vice-Dale County (the county label sits just above Hamlet on the map)
2. Take the white Apollo van parked outside, not the teddy bear van by the shutters
3. Open the side door. On your first visit everyone inside is already dead, so there is no fight
4. Loot the bodies for cash and weapons (a Type 9 SMG near the door, a Duke 556 assault rifle further in), the duffel bag of marked bills on the table, and the cocaine in the van inside
5. The offices have more product on the tables and cash on the desk
6. The safe: use the right stick to find the spot. Inside is a collectible card, and the game says pawn shops buy them
7. Open the shutter: the second van outside has even more cocaine
8. Fill your duffel bags first, then stow the full bags in the van. Stay with the van
9. The glitch: drive away for about half a minute, turn around and come back. The shutters are down again and the van's cocaine is back. If the shutters are still up, drive further
10. Repeat until the van is full, then sell at Brian's lockup (compare what each buyer pays on the map first)

CHAPTERS
0:00 The money glitch, any chapter
0:16 Where it is and which van
0:29 First visit loot: the door, bodies, guns and the duffel bag
0:48 The van and the offices
1:01 The safe and the collectible card
1:13 The second van
1:26 Fill the bags, fill the van
1:41 The glitch: drive away and come back
2:04 One full loop, sped up
2:27 Repeat it, then sell
2:43 Brian's lockup and my tip

This can get patched. Check your own game before you rely on any step.
